To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we propose a probabilistic model to jointly infer entity mentions and their relations in a KB, (2) the model exploits the power-law distributions of entity and relation frequencies in the world knowledge, and (3) our approach yields state-of-the-art performance on a challenging cold start KB population problem. 2

the following question: How can we use world knowledge to improve KB construction?
